structured_output.mechanisms: Time scales with epochs × per-epoch cost (conv widths, mostly stage-2/3 width), cut by the low-res phase fraction, slightly by larger batch, and raised ~9–13% by Muon overhead. Accuracy rises with epochs, width and Muon. It falls with cutout, larger translate, random flip, no label smoothing, a long low-res phase (nonlinear) and very large batch. Accuracy-versus-time trades decide which runs reach 75.3%.
